title: Green-Function Monotonicity under Positive Bakry-Émery Curvature
summary: Inspired by the Green-function monotonicity formulas of Colding, Minicozzi, and Manea, we establish weighted monotonicity formulas on closed weighted Riemannian manifolds satisfying ${\rm Ric}_f^m \ge (m-1)kg$, where $m>n\ge 3$ and $k>0$. Our results extend Manea's elliptic monotonicity framework to the setting of finite-dimensional Bakry-Émery curvature and provide a positive-curvature counterpart to the weighted formulas of Song-Wei-Wu.
